title: Change briefing
intro: Catch up on committed source changes, grouped by the capabilities recorded in this folder.
timezone: Dates use {timezone}; both selected dates are included.
invalidRange: Choose valid dates with the start on or before the end.
webTitle: Source history needs the installed app
webBody: Open an ontology folder in the installed app to read its connected source repository's history.
noVault: Open a folder to read its connected source history.
noProject: This folder has no project to read source history for.
sourceUnavailable: The connected source folder is unavailable. Check its connection and folder permission, then retry.
noHistory: This source repository has no readable committed history.
readError: Could not read the source history. Your dates are kept; try again.
stale: The repository or its connection changed while reading. Refresh to compare one source snapshot.
empty: No commits found in this period.
emptyHint: Choose another period or refresh after new commits.
head: Read at {hash}
scope: Current branch first-parent history. Commits inside merged branches are not counted separately. Uncommitted changes are excluded.
totals: {commits} first-parent commits · {files} touched files · {groups} capability groups
partial: Showing a limited read of this period. Narrow the dates for a more complete briefing.
limit: Read limits: {limit} commits · 8 MiB history output · 20,000 path records. Totals cover only returned evidence.
unmappedHint: These paths have no matching implementation anchor in the current folder. Their behavior has not been classified.
groupingNote: Groups use current recorded implementation paths. They do not prove what a capability did historically.
selectGroup: Choose a capability group to inspect its source evidence.
commitAttribution: Messages written by commit authors; Atlas has not verified their behavior claims.
comparisonNote: This compares the shown revisions. With out-of-order commit dates, intervening commits outside the selected dates can affect this comparison.
netEmpty: These revisions have no file differences. Commits may still have touched files during the period.
netUnavailable: The endpoint comparison is unavailable. Touched paths and commit messages remain inspectable.
initialTree: Empty tree before the first commit
patchLoading: Reading this file between the shown revisions…
patchTruncated: Showing the first 32 KiB of this file comparison. This is not the complete patch.
patchBinary: This is a binary file. A line-by-line comparison is unavailable.
patchUnavailable: Could not read this file comparison. The file list and commit messages are still available.
patchNoDifference: This file has no differences between the shown revisions. It may have changed and been reverted during the period.
patchSelect: Choose a file to read its changed lines here.
sourceAreaNote: Grouped by source paths, not product capabilities. These changes remain unmapped.
comparisonScope: The comparison covers the entire source repository, independently of the selected group.
overviewTitle: Start with where the files changed
overviewHint: Choose an area to read its changed files. File activity does not establish a behavior change.
areasShown: Showing the {count} largest source areas. All areas remain in unmapped changes.
findFile: 変更したファイルを探す
noMatchingFiles: 一致するファイルがありません。検索語を変更するか消してください。
